evidence_items.claim: Miki Cheung (Regulatory Program Manager, Société Générale) participated in Informa Trade & Transaction Reporting Summit panel discussing regulatory reporting processes and control frameworks
evidence_items.excerpt: A session featured Miki Cheung (Regulatory Program Manager, Societe Generale) alongside other industry professionals. The discussion centred on updating control frameworks and evaluating reporting processes effectiveness.
evidence_items.caveats: Conference participation shows awareness of CDM/DRR trends but does not confirm implementation. Panel focused on regulatory reporting generally, not CDM specifically.

evidence_items.claim: Société Générale official EMIR compliance page documents EU EMIR Refit (April 2024) and UK EMIR Refit (September 2024) requirements
evidence_items.excerpt: EU EMIR Refit revised transaction reporting standards apply from 29 April 2024, while UK EMIR Refit revised reporting requirements apply from 30 September 2024.
evidence_items.caveats: Standard regulatory compliance information. Does not indicate CDM usage - could be traditional or CDM-based approach. No evidence of CDM/DRR implementation.

evidence_items.claim: Risk.net awarded Société Générale 'Derivatives Client Clearer of the Year' (Nov 2024) - post-trade platform expansion but no CDM mention
evidence_items.excerpt: Societe Generale's edge comes from a post-trade platform and clearing capability expansion. Globally, the firm boasts an 11.8% market share for exchange-traded derivatives clearing.
evidence_items.caveats: Award for derivatives clearing excellence. No mention of CDM in post-trade platform - suggests traditional infrastructure.
